about: NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY room package for r108 with both PS2 cast members (lane p2b B3): the female Ganado (em17 type 0xc, PS2_GANADO_F, GC hair mask) and the crow (em23 folded / spread, PS2_CROW). Render only; descriptors of ps2-ganado-f17-mask and ps2-crow, from one merged cast dir (merge_cast.py).
lighting: em17: the source GX lighting record (NATIVE_MODEL_REGISTRY_SOURCE_LIGHT bits 2 and 4); crow: the source GX lighting record and source cull, as ps2-crow

descriptors.name: ganado-em17-0c
